title: Law to study bias in building violation enforcement
summary: This law would require the Department of Buildings, with help from the Department of Finance and the Department of Housing Preservation and Development, to study racial, geographic and socioeconomic disparities in building violation enforcement, penalties, inspections, tax lien sales and foreclosures. The study must cover at least the prior 10 years of data and be reported to the mayor and Council speaker within one year of the law taking effect. The report must also include policy recommendations to address any disparities found.
